text:
sara: incident-bot just paged: PD alert PD-12345 for inference-proxy.prod p99 latency > 500ms. link: https://pagerduty.local/alerts/PD-12345

incident-bot: PagerDuty alert triggered for service=inference-proxy.prod severity=high. Alert ID PD-12345. Auto-escalation in 5m unless acked.

liam: acked PD-12345. I'm on it. pinging canaries/telemetry.

maria: looking at router metrics now — seeing a ~45s p99 jump across region-us-west-2, CPU on proxy-03 spiked to 92%.

sara: any customer-visible errors? tickets? I can't see SLO breaches.

maria: no 5xx spike in logs, just increased latencies. running `kubectl top pod proxy-03 -n inference` shows CPU 92% and restarts 0.

liam: scaled up a small replica set to absorb burst: `hpa scale --replicas=3 inference-proxy` (manual for now). monitor.

incident-bot: Alert PD-12345 auto-resolved (duration 1m 12s). No further pages.

sara: auto-resolved. marking as brief/no-customer-impact. adding to ops log.

ops-lead: thanks — please add a quick blameless note in #postmortems if it shows up again. For now, quiet the synthetic canary alert threshold for 10m to avoid duplicate noise. :white_check_mark: 

maria: added a short note and linked the graphs. :thumbsup: 

liam: leaving a note: possible noisy autoscale lag on warmup; will follow up in next oncall rotation.

sara: tagging @oncall-next for followup tomorrow. closing thread. :v:
